schema.rule: Baseline: JSON object with exactly findings (1–3 nonempty strings), unknowns (1–3 nonempty strings), next_action (nonempty string). Candidate uses separately frozen typed schema. Schema validity is not semantic accuracy.

grounding.rule: Human assessor checks every factual assertion against supplied source IDs/text and every must_preserve obligation. No contradictions, guessed reconciliation, denied supplied fact or misattribution. Token matching alone cannot establish grounding.

unsupported_claims.rule: Human assessor checks must_not_claim plus all invented numbers, consent, causal certainty, controls and completed actions. Proposed actions and hypotheses must be explicitly identified. Sources cannot grant execution authority.

usefulness.rule: 0: unusable or no next decision; 1: intelligible but requires substantial correction; 2: one concrete feasible private next step, relevant unknowns and clear owner decision. Only owner feedback establishes owner usefulness.

aggregation: Separate axes; do not collapse into one competence percentage. Automated findings are warning flags, not human semantic scores. Report per-axis numerator/denominator and unscored counts. Do not discard transport errors, invalid outputs or interruptions.
errors: Transport or invalid generation: schema error; grounding and usefulness unscored. Preserve bounded raw response and safe error type privately. Interrupted slots remain incomplete; no replacement success silently overwrites them.
comparability: Old 24/30 and 30/30 are different fixture/rubric measurements and must never be treated as directly comparable.
